en: I'm Meyer. I manage the theater.
We've only just finished building this,
you see. Built with the latest technology,
it's a fine, well-equipped theater.
Oh, I'm so busy, so busy!
Hey, you there! Carry that more carefully!
note: No used_in; Meyer ordering workers (next to #4005/#4007).

en: No, no, no! You can't dawdle on the job!
Well? Isn't it a splendid theater?
For the opening, I'll bring in top actors
and put on some Shakespeare, perhaps.
We'll pack the house and make a fortune!
It's no good.
I still haven't found a replacement show.
Good grief. The troupe booked for the opening
suddenly backed out on me.
What am I going to do
At this rate,
we won't be ready for the grand opening.
I've got to find a replacement show fast,
but
if you know anyone good, please tell me.
What? You know someone who could perform?
Yes. An opera singer, a woman called Dehmel.
Her singing is quite something.
She's staying at the Lion Inn now.
Wonderful! I'll go and talk to her at once
and get her to perform for us.
what a splendid performance that was!
Today was a huge success.
Thanks to you, the theater's doing well.
Hm? Who is it, at this hour
I'm glad your theater is a success.
? Oh, it's you.
It's all thanks to you.
I can't thank you enough.
I need no thanks.
I'll take a reward instead.
A reward?
You can't just spring that on me!
The theater's only just getting started,
there's no way I can pay you!
I don't want money.
I want only what you are able to give.
note: Sinister: he wants something Meyer can give (his service), not money.

en: Oh, forgive me, I misunderstood.
I'll do anything within my power.
Waaagh!
note: No used_in; scream (likely Meyer being bitten).

en: How quickly he changes his tune.

en: Every piece here is fine handmade work.
The shop's closed right now.
We're open from 13:00 to 16:00.
Sorry, but could you come back later?
This is "Helmut's Furniture".
It's all handmade, so I really need time
with the shop shut to make the furniture.
Come back during opening hours.
How's your custom furniture working out?
Just say the word,
and I'll build you any furniture you like!
This is "Helmut's Furniture".
What kind of furniture are you after?
Wardrobes, cupboards, beds...
We've got anything you need!
Yep, and if there's anything you don't like,
I'll even make it over again!
Take your time and look around.
Even when you place an order, I can't
make it right away.
So just bear with me a little.
At my shop, it's usually newlywed women
who do the buying.
